title: Privacy Policy
html:
PRIVACY POLICY

Effective Date:  February 20, 2024

Thank you for choosing MODISHYE (“we,” “our,” or “us”). This Privacy Policy elucidates our approach to managing your Personal Information throughout your interactions with our website, transactions, or utilization of our services. Your satisfaction and trust in us are paramount, and we appreciate your  interest in our community. This policy prioritizes transparency, clarifying how we responsibly handle your Personal Information as you navigate our website, purchase, or utilize our various features. Our Privacy Policy outlines the collection, utilization, disclosure, and safeguarding of your information when you engage with MODHISHYE. By utilizing our services, you consent to the terms delineated in this policy.

This Privacy Policy applies to the actions of MODISHYE but does not encompass the practices of entities and other third parties not owned or controlled by us, including our customers and third parties offering products through our Service (e.g., via the MODISHYE Marketplace, where customers can purchase products on our website). You are responsible for ensuring that you have obtained the necessary permissions and approvals for any Personal Information you share with us for use in accordance with this Privacy Policy. Specifically, our customers assure MODISHYE that they possess the requisite rights under applicable law or have obtained the necessary consent from each end user whose Personal Information is provided by the customer to MODISHYE, enabling us to use, disclose, and process such Personal Information for the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy and as described herein.

Data Controller: MODISHYE.
Contact information: e-mail address: support@accordingtomodishyeblog.com.

  1. Interpretation and Legal References

1.1 Personal Information (or Information):

Any data that directly, indirectly, or in conjunction with other data — including a personal identification number — enables the identification or identifiability of an individual.

1.2 Utilization Information:

Data gathered automatically through this Website (or third-party services employed in this Website), which may include: (i) the IP addresses or domain names of the computers used by the Users accessing this Website, (ii) the URI addresses (Uniform Resource Identifier), (iii) the time of the request, the method used to submit the request to the server, the size of the file received in response, (iv) the numerical code indicating the status of the server’s response (successful outcome, error, etc.), (v) the country of origin, the characteristics of the browser and operating system used by the User, (vi) the various time details per visit (e.g., the duration spent on each page within the Website), and; (vii) the details about the path followed within the Website with particular reference to the sequence of pages visited, along with other parameters about the device operating system and/or the User’s IT environment.

1.3 User:

a) The individual utilizing this Website who, unless otherwise indicated, corresponds to the Data Subject.

(i) Data Subject: The natural person to whom the Personal Information pertains.
(ii) Data Processor (or Data Controller): The natural or legal entity, public authority, agency, or other body that processes Personal Information on behalf of the Controller, as outlined in this privacy policy.
(iii) Data Controller (or Owner): The natural or legal entity, public authority, agency, or other body that, individually or jointly with others, determines the purposes and means of processing Personal Information, including the security measures related to the operation and use of this Website. Unless otherwise specified, the Data Controller is the Owner of this Website.
(iv) This Website: The platform through which the Personal Information of the User is collected and processed.
(v) Service: The offerings provided by this Website, as detailed in the corresponding terms and conditions and on this Website.

  1. Information Collection:

2.1 Personal Data:

During your interaction with our platform and while making purchases, we collect vital personal information, including, but not limited to, your name, contact details, billing and shipping addresses, and payment particulars. This data enables us to process your orders and efficiently deliver a seamless shopping experience.

2.2 Device Details:

a) To optimize your browsing experience, we automatically gather information concerning your device, such as your IP address, browser type, operating system, and browsing data. Understanding device specifications helps us tailor our platform to ensure compatibility and smooth navigation.

2.3 Usage Statistics:

In our commitment to enhancing user experience, we collect usage statistics encompassing your platform interactions. This may include pages visited, time spent on each page, and products viewed. Analyzing usage patterns enables us to refine our services, making your online journey with us more personalized and enjoyable.

2.4 Technical Specifications:

a) Your login credentials, time zone settings, browser specifications, IP address, geographical location, operating system details, and identity documentation.

2.5 Payment Details:

a) Information pertaining to payment methods, including credit card particulars.

b.) Payment Processing:

When you choose to utilize Apple Pay or Google Pay for transactions on our website, your payment details are securely processed through their respective payment gateways. By opting to use Apple Pay or Google Pay, you acknowledge and consent to the processing of your payment information in accordance with their respective terms of service and privacy policies. We do not store or have access to your payment credentials. Please review Apple’s and Google’s policies to understand their practices regarding the collection, use, and protection of your payment information.

2.6 Marketing Insights:

a) Occasionally, we may conduct surveys, contests, or events, using your account details to identify you. Additionally, we may collect information provided by you, such as your name, email address, phone number, organization name and address, and general details about your employer, if applicable. Furthermore, we might engage third-party service providers to collect business-related data about your employer, such as its name, size, and revenue, for potential service offerings or analytical purposes.

2.7 MODISHYE Collaborators and Partners:

a) MODISHYE collects the business contact information of individuals associated with our collaborators and other partners to maintain communication regarding their business affiliations with MODISHYE.

2.8 Subscribing to Our E-mail List:

a) When you subscribe to our e-mail list, we use your e-mail to send you updates, news, and commercial messages to your e-mail.

2.9 Data Collection for Managing Litigation and Legal Compliance:

We collect data to adhere to legal requests or handle litigation and Data required to demonstrate MODISHYE’s adherence to its obligations and/or manage legal proceedings.

  1. Collection of Data Clause:

3.1 Methods of Data Collection:

a) MODISHYE gathers and processes information based on your utilization of our services. This information is acquired through various channels, including online forms, email/chat exchanges, and telephonic discussions with our consultants. Additionally, specific details are automatically gathered through tools such as cookies.

3.2. Sources of Information:

a) MODISHYE collects Personal Information directly from you and/or your devices, including not limited to:

(i) Service Data: When you use our website, you may provide us with Personal Information, which may include credentials, qualifications, and other relevant data. This information is collected to facilitate your use of the website and to provide a more personalized experience.

(ii) Transaction Reporting: Financial information necessary for processing transactions, such as photo ID, bank details, and/or credit card numbers, may be provided by you.

(iii) Surveys: Participation in surveys conducted by us or our partner companies, including feedback within the Service, questionnaires, telephone interviews, or discussion groups, may require providing Personal Information.

(iv) Analytics Data and Tools: We collect analytics data directly or through third-party tools to analyze trends and improve the product.

(v) Cookies and Tracking Technologies: Information is collected over time using cookies and tracking technologies.

(vi) Other Users of Our Service: If you are a customer or collaborator who uses MODISHYE, we may collect your Personal Information.

(vii) Our Affiliates: Personal Information may be collected from our affiliates.

(viii) Governmental Entities: Background checks or collection of publicly available information from governmental sources may be conducted.

(ix) Business Partners: Financial information related to your business may be collected from third-party sources such as payment processors, verification vendors, and accounting service providers.

(x) Social Media Usage: If you choose to log in using your Social Media Profiles/Pages/Groups, we may collect your information.

(xi) Public Sources: Information from publicly available sources, such as your website, may also be collected.

(xii) This Privacy Policy pertains to MODISHYE’s activities and does not extend to practices of third parties, including our customers and other companies offering products or services through our platform. It is your responsibility to ensure that necessary authorizations and consents are obtained for any Personal Information provided to us.

  1. Objectives of Data Collection:

4.1 Marketing Communications:

a) MODISHYE utilizes your contact details to inform you about our latest products, services, promotions, and relevant updates. This enables us to deliver personalized content and ensure you are informed about offers tailored to your preferences.

4.2 Integration and Collaboration Platform:

a) Our integration and collaboration platform is a centralized hub to enhance your website experience. This feature facilitates seamless integration of various functionalities and promotes collaboration, fostering a more connected and efficient user experience.

4.3 Enhancing MODISHYE:

a) Continuous enhancement is paramount to us. We utilize your feedback and analyze user interactions to improve our website, services, and overall user experience. This ensures we remain responsive to your needs and provide a platform aligned with the latest market trends.

4.4 Customer Assistance:

a) Our customer support team assists you with any queries, concerns, or issues encountered while using our platform. This ensures you can access necessary support and guidance for a seamless interaction with our website.

4.5 Safeguarding Data Integrity:

a) Upholding data integrity is a core value for us. We implement robust security measures to safeguard your personal information and transactions, ensuring the integrity of our platform. This includes encryption, secure access controls, and other measures to maintain a secure and trustworthy environment for our users.

4.6 Preventing Fraudulent Activities:

a) We prioritize data and transaction security by actively implementing fraud prevention measures. This involves monitoring for suspicious behavior, employing advanced authentication methods, and maintaining lists to identify and prevent fraudulent activities to ensure a secure and trustworthy environment for our users.

4.7 Compliance with Legal Requirements:

a) Our processing of your personal data is based on legal grounds, including consent, contractual execution, legal compliance, protection of vital interests, performance of public tasks, and pursuit of legitimate interests, always respecting your fundamental rights and complying with Federal and State laws.

4.8 Data Processing and Transfer:

a) Initial processing of your Personal Information occurs in the USA, ensuring compliance with relevant data protection standards for storage and further processing.

4.9 Third-Party Partnerships:

a) We may disclose your Personal Information to third parties with whom we have partnered to offer a product or service.

4.10 Business Transfers:

a) In the event of a merger, acquisition, or transfer of our business or assets, we may disclose your Personal Information. We will provide prior notice and, if legally required, an opportunity to object to this disclosure.

4.11 Other Scenarios:

a) We may seek your consent to disclose your information to other third parties not explicitly described in this Privacy Policy.

  1. Data Processing Methods:

5.1 MODISHYE employs robust security measures to safeguard against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or data destruction.

5.2 Data processing occurs using computer systems and/or IT tools, adhering to organizational protocols and methods directly linked to the specified purposes. Alongside MODISHYE certain individuals responsible for various functions within the website’s operation (including administration, sales, marketing, legal, and system administration) may have access to the data. External entities such as third-party technical service providers, mail carriers, hosting providers, IT firms, and communication agencies may also have access to the data if designated as Data Processors by MODISHYE. Upon request, an updated roster of these parties can be obtained from the Owner.

5.3 MODISHYE prioritizes the security and confidentiality of your data, ensuring that it is handled with the utmost care and in accordance with relevant regulations.

  1. Transfers and Sharing of Data:

6.1 Depending on the User’s location, data transfers may entail moving the User’s Data to a country different from their own. Should such a transfer occur, Users can acquire further details by referring to the relevant sections of this document or contacting MODISHYE through the contact information provided.

6.2 MODISHYE may store, process, and/or transfer personal data to countries beyond the European Economic Area (EEA) (including countries where the European Commission has not rendered a decision regarding an adequate level of protection of personal data), but we will seek your consent in such instances.

We may share your personal data with the following recipients:

a) Internal Recipients: Your Personal data will solely be disclosed to authorized personnel who require access to fulfill their duties (e.g., support teams, developers, etc.).

b) Processors: In order to deliver the Services, MODISHYE may relay your Personal data to other entities acting as data processors.

c) Partners and Third Parties: To deliver the Services, MODISHYE may divulge your Personal Data to third-party service providers. These partners and third parties function as Data controllers and maintain their own Privacy policies, which you should thoroughly review if utilizing their services.

d) Judicial, Administrative, and Other Public Authorities: MODISHYE may be obligated to share or disclose some of your Personal data if required by law, by a request from a competent authority, to comply with a court order, to pursue legal remedies, or to defend MODISHYE’s rights, and to assist with investigations (e.g., fraud, identity theft, etc.).

7. Retention of Data:

7.1 MODISHYE will process and store Personal Data for as long as necessary for the purposes for which they were collected. Therefore:

a) Personal Data collected for Contractual purposes between MODISHYE and the User will be retained for the duration of the Contract between the parties.

b) Personal data collected based on User Consent will be retained as long as the User has provided Consent.

c) Personal Data collected for MODISHYE’s legitimate interests will be retained for the period required to fulfill such interests. Users can find specific details regarding MODISHYE’s legitimate interests below.

Purpose Legal basis
Offering communication between MODISHYE and the visitor. Legitimate interest of MODISHYE to offer visitors an efficient way to communicate with its teams.
Responding to the User/visitor’s request for information related to the Services offered by MODISHYE or request for assistance Legitimate interest of MODISHYE to offer its visitors a mean to contact support teams. Contract with User
Manage the request(s) of the Users related to their data protection rights Legal obligation of MODISHYE, especially regarding GDPR compliance.
Enhance and improve the Services and Website Legitimate interests of MODISHYE to offer optimized Services.

MODISHYE may continue to retain Personal Data for an extended period if the User has consented to such processing, provided such consent is not revoked. Additionally, MODISHYE may be required to retain Personal Data for longer to fulfill legal obligations or comply with authority orders.

7.2 Upon expiration of the retention period, Personal Data will be deleted. Consequently, access, erasure, rectification, and data portability rights cannot be exercised after the retention period lapses.

7.3 Following the termination or deactivation of your user profile on MODISHYE, we may retain your Personal Information for various purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy, including marketing, backup, archival, protection of MODISHYE’s rights and those of its customers and third parties, audit purposes, or as permitted by law.

  1. Rights Under Data Protection Regulations:

8.1 In compliance with relevant data protection regulations, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and Data Protection Act 2018, individuals interacting with our website are afforded specific rights to safeguard their personal data:

a) Right to Access: Individuals maintain the right to determine whether our website processes their personal data and, if so, to access such information.

b) Right to Rectification: Individuals can request the correction of any inaccuracies in their personal data and the completion of any incomplete information.

c) Right to Erasure (Right to be Forgotten): Individuals possess the right to request the deletion of their personal data under certain circumstances, such as when the data is no longer necessary or when consent is withdrawn.

d) Right to Restriction of Processing: Individuals can request limitations on processing their personal data, allowing for storage without further processing.

e) Right to Data Portability: Individuals can obtain their personal data in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format and transfer it to another data controller.

f) Right to Object: Individuals can raise objections to the processing of their personal data, particularly in cases of direct marketing or when processing is based on the data controller’s legitimate interests.

g) Rights Related to Automated Decision Making: Individuals have the right not to be subject to decisions based solely on automated processing, including profiling, that significantly affects them.

h) Data Security: Robust physical and electronic security measures securely store and protect your information. All personal data is managed in accordance with the provisions outlined in the Data Protection Act 2018.

  1. Additional Information Regarding Data Handling:

9.1 Legal Proceedings:

a) MODISHYE may utilize the User’s Personal Data for legal purposes, including court proceedings or pre-litigation procedures resulting from the misuse of this Website or its associated Services.

9.2 System Logs and Maintenance:

a) For the upkeep and smooth operation of this Website, as well as any third-party services integrated with it, system logs may be collected. These logs record interactions with the Website and may utilize other Personal Data, such as IP addresses, for maintenance purposes.

9.3 Additional Information:

a) For further details regarding the collection or processing of Personal Data, individuals may contact support@accordingtomodishyeblog.com.

9.4 Third-Party Websites:

a) Our Website may feature links or references to third-party websites. Please note that these sites are beyond our control, and their privacy policies may differ from ours. Our Privacy Notice does not extend to these third-party sites.

9.5 We advise users to review such website’s terms of use and privacy policies before disclosing any personal information. The privacy practices of these third-party sites govern the use of information collected from users.

9.6 Children’s Privacy:

a) Our site caters to a general audience and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from individuals under the age permitted by law. If you are a parent or guardian and believe that we have collected information from your child in a manner contrary to legal requirements, please contact us using the details provided above. We will take appropriate steps to remove such data in compliance with applicable laws.

  1. Update to the Privacy Policy:

10.1 MODISHYE is dedicated to maintaining transparency and protecting your privacy. As part of this commitment, we reserve the right to update and modify this privacy policy as needed.

a) Notification of Changes: MODISHYE may update this privacy policy anytime. Users will be notified of any changes through this webpage within the Website. It is advisable for users to regularly review this page, taking note of the date of the last modification provided at the bottom. If the changes impact processing activities based on user consent, MODISHYE will seek new consent from the user where necessary.

b) Ongoing Evaluation and Improvement: We are committed to continually evaluating and enhancing our privacy policy to protect your information better. Revisions to this policy will be readily accessible on this webpage, ensuring that users are informed and empowered. We may periodically revise or update this Privacy Policy to reflect changes in our operations and practices. Significant changes will be indicated by updating the ‘last modified’ date at the top of this Privacy Policy. By continuing to use the Service after the revised Privacy Policy has been implemented, you acknowledge that you have reviewed, understood, and consented to the current version of the Privacy Policy.

Updated on: April 4, 2024

TERMS OF SERVICE

Effective Date: February 19, 2024

  1. Introduction:

Welcome to MODISHYE Blog! We are the operators of this Website. By accessing any part of the site, you agree to adhere to the terms and conditions outlined herein. These Terms of Service apply to all Users; reviewing them before utilizing our Website is essential. If you disagree with any portion of these terms, kindly refrain from accessing the site or utilizing any of its services. Any new features or tools introduced on the site will also be subject to these terms. You must be at least sixteen (16) years old to access and utilize the Website and app. By using this Website and/or the app, you acknowledge that you have read and accepted these Terms of Service, constituting a legally binding agreement between you and MODISHYE Blog governed by Texas State Law, United States. Failure to agree to these terms necessitates refraining from using the app, Website, or any associated content or services. The terms “you” or “your” pertain to the individual or legal entity identified as the user upon registration on the Website or app.

MODISHYE Blog provides access to digital products. These items, curated by MODISHYE Blog’s creator, Yeyeside Talabi, are designed to meet the needs of our customers and offer a mix of educational insights and personal reflections across categories including, but not limited to Culture, Finance, Passions, and Education. We aim to inspire you to navigate life’s challenges using the practical tips shared in our blog.

Your usage of our Service is authorized solely for personal use. We reserve the right to update or modify these Terms of Service at any time by posting changes on the Website. It is your responsibility to check for updates regularly. Your continued use of the Website after changes are posted indicates acceptance of those changes.

a) Products must only be used for lawful and authorized purposes.

b) Service usage must adhere to the laws of your jurisdiction, including copyright laws.

2.2 Age Representation:

a) By accepting these Terms of Service, you affirm that you are of legal age in your state or province.

b) If you are of legal age and provide consent, minors under your care may use this site.

2.3 Prohibited Activities:

a) Transmitting worms, viruses, or any malicious code is strictly prohibited.

2.4 Violation Consequences:

a) Violating any Terms will result in immediate termination of your Services.

3. Acceptance of Privacy Policy:

3.1 Acknowledgment of Privacy Policy:

Upon acceptance of this Agreement, you acknowledge and agree to comply with the terms outlined in the MODISHYE Blog’s Privacy Policy. The Privacy Policy offers detailed information on the handling of your data. If you disagree with any terms of the Privacy Policy, it is advisable to refrain from using the Site.

  1. General Conditions:

4.1 Right to Refuse Service:

a) We reserve the right to refuse service to any individual at our discretion and for any reason.

4.2 Content Transmission:

a) Your content, excluding credit card information, may be transmitted unencrypted, including over various networks and technical adaptations.

4.3 Credit Card Information Encryption:

a) Credit card information is consistently encrypted during transmission across networks to ensure security.

4.4 Usage Restrictions:

a) Reproducing, duplicating, copying, selling, reselling, or exploiting any part of the Service, its usage, or access without our explicit written consent is prohibited.

4.5 Headings for Convenience:

a) The headings used in this agreement are for convenience only and do not impose limitations or affect these Terms.

4.6 Customer Information:

a) Any customer data provided or imported by MODISHYE Blog shall remain its property.

b) By using the Service, you authorize MODISHYE Blog and its affiliates to use, modify, execute, display, distribute, and disclose such customer data as necessary to provide the Service and for internal business purposes by MODISHYE Blog’s privacy policy.

4.7 Service Pricing Information:

a) Pricing information for services entered or imported by Users shall remain the property of MODISHYE Blog. Individual pricing data will not be disclosed to third parties without user consent; however, MODISHYE Blog reserves the right to aggregate and anonymize pricing data for business purposes.

4.8 Feedback:

a) By providing feedback regarding the Service, including any flaws, errors, bugs, or suggestions for improvement (“Feedback”), you grant us all rights, including intellectual property rights, in the Feedback. This includes the right to utilize the Feedback and related information in any manner we deem appropriate.

4.9 User Content Guidelines:

a) Our platform allows Users to create and share various content, including text, images, videos, and comments, referred to as “Contributions.” When making Contributions, Users must adhere to the following guidelines:
(i) Ensure Contributions do not infringe upon the rights of third parties.(ii) Obtain necessary permissions for using Contributions on our platform.(iii) Obtain consent from identifiable individuals featured in Contributions.(iv) Ensure Contributions are accurate, truthful, and respectful.(v) Refrain from solicitation, spam, or unauthorized advertising.(vi) Comply with all applicable laws and regulations, including privacy and hate speech laws.(vii) Avoid offensive or discriminatory content based on race, nationality, gender, etc.(viii) Violation of these guidelines may result in termination or suspension of access to the platform.(viii) We reserve the right to moderate user content and remove inappropriate content. Users are responsible for the accuracy and legality of their Contributions, and we assume no liability for user-generated content.

5. Payment Policy:

5.1 At MODISHYE Blog, we require full payment in advance for all the products we offer.

5.2 We offer our customers the convenience of multiple payment methods, including credit card, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. By selecting Apple Pay or Google Pay as your preferred payment method, you agree to comply with their respective terms of service and privacy policies. You understand and agree that any transactions conducted through Apple Pay or Google Pay are subject to the terms and conditions set forth by Apple Inc. and Google LLC. We shall not be responsible for any disputes, claims, or liabilities arising from your use of Apple Pay or Google Pay. It is important that you take the time to review and adhere to the terms and policies established by Apple and Google for using their payment services.

5.3 When customers opt to provide their credit card information, they authorize MODISHYE Blog to automatically charge their card for any charges applicable to their account.

5.4 Please note that failure to make timely payments may result in suspending access to the digital products you purchased until the outstanding balance is settled. We aim to ensure seamless access to our digital products while maintaining financial integrity.

  1. Refund and Cancellation Policy:

At MODISHYE Blog, we prioritize transparency and user satisfaction. Here’s what you need to know about our refund and cancellation policy:

6.1 Delivery of Digital Content:

a) Unless explicitly specified otherwise, digital content purchased on our Website is delivered via download on the User’s chosen device(s). It is important to note that Users must have legal, commonly used, up-to-date software (including operating systems) on their intended device(s) to download and/or use the product effectively. Users understand and accept that the ability to download the purchased product may be subject to limitations based on time and geographical location.

6.2 Cancellation Process:

a) Cancellations become effective on the day they are processed by MODISHYE. Upon cancellation, customers will receive an email notification confirming the cancellation request.

6.3 Refund Policy:

a) MODISHYE Blog does not issue refunds for any fees paid by customers unless there is a material breach of the agreement by MODISHYE. Our refund policy outlines specific scenarios in which refunds may be considered. For detailed information on our refund policy, please refer to the dedicated section on our Website.

7. User Registration:

At MODISHYE Blog, we value transparency and security in our user registration process. Here’s what you need to know:

7.1 Registration Requirements:

a) To access specific features of our Website, App, and/or Service, Users must register. During registration, Users must provide their complete legal name, a valid email address, and any other details requested in the signup process. By registering, Users commit to providing accurate, up-to-date, and comprehensive information as prompted by the registration form.

7.2 Alternative Registration Methods:

a) In addition to the standard registration process, Users can access our Website, App, and/or Service by linking certain social networking services (SNSs) they are connected to or through an account with the App provider for their mobile device.

7.3 Privacy Policy:

a) Any personal information provided during the registration process will be handled and stored in accordance with the MODISHYE Blog Privacy Policy. We prioritize the protection of user data and ensure compliance with privacy regulations.

7.4 Email Collection:

a) As part of our service, we collect email addresses from Users who download content from our Website. We handle this information in line with our Privacy Policy.

8.Products and Services:

8.1 Sales Limitations:

a) While we aim to make our products and services accessible to everyone, we reserve the right to limit sales to certain individuals, geographic regions, or jurisdictions. This allows us to ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations. We may exercise this right on a case-by-case basis to maintain the integrity of our offerings.

8.2 Quantity Limitations

a) We also reserve the right to limit the quantities of any products or services we offer. This helps us manage inventory and ensure all customers can access our offerings.

8.3 Flexible Pricing and Descriptions:

a) All descriptions of products or product pricing are subject to change at any time without prior notice. We may update pricing or product descriptions at our sole discretion to reflect market conditions or product enhancements. Additionally, we reserve the right to discontinue any product anytime if it no longer aligns with our standards or business objectives.

8.4 Quality Assurance:

a) While we strive to deliver high-quality products and services, we cannot guarantee they will meet every customer’s expectations. We are committed to promptly addressing issues and ensuring customer satisfaction. If you encounter any errors or have concerns about our services, please contact our support team at support@accordingtomodishyeblog.com

8.5 Legal Compliance:

a) It’s important to note that any offer for products or services on our site is void where the law prohibits it. We adhere to all relevant regulations and laws governing the sale and distribution of our products and services.

9.Third-party Engagement:

9.1 Diverse Content and Services:

a) Our Service may feature content, products, and services sourced from third-party providers. These offerings complement our own and enrich the user experience by providing diverse perspectives and resources.

9.2 External Links Disclaimer:

a) Please note that third-party links on our site may redirect you to external Websites that are not under our control. While we strive to ensure the quality and relevance of these links, we do not have direct control over their content or accuracy.

9.3 No Endorsement or Warranty:

a) Our Website may contain links to Websites and features advertised through banners or other forms of promotion. MODISHYE Blog does not endorse or warrant the content of these external links, nor do we monitor or assess them for accuracy, adequacy, validity, reliability, availability, or completeness. We expressly disclaim any warranty, endorsement, guarantee, or assumption of responsibility for the accuracy or reliability of information provided by third-party Websites linked through our site or any Websites advertised through banners or other promotions. Additionally, we are not involved in or responsible for any transactions between you and third-party providers of products or services. We do not assume any liability or responsibility for any issues arising from your interaction with third-party content or services.

9.4 Purchase and Usage Risks:

a) We want our Users to make informed decisions when engaging with third-party content, products, or services. We are not liable for any harm, damages, or issues related to your transactions with third-party Websites. It’s essential to review and understand the policies and practices of these third parties before engaging in any transactions or interactions.

9.5 Addressing Concerns:

a) If you encounter any complaints, claims, concerns, or questions regarding third-party products or services, we encourage you to contact the third-party provider directly. They will be better equipped to address and resolve any issues you may have.

10.Mistakes, Inaccuracies, and Omissions:

10.1 Potential Errors, Inaccuracies, and Omissions:

a) Our Website or content may contain errors, inaccuracies, or omissions, particularly in product descriptions, pricing, promotions, shipping charges, transit times, and availability. We reserve the right to correct any such errors, inaccuracies, or omissions and to modify or update information or cancel orders if necessary without prior notice, even after an order has been submitted.

10.2 Information Update Policy:

a) We are not obligated to update, amend, or clarify information on the Service or related Websites, including pricing information, except as required by law. The absence of a specific update or refresh date does not imply that all information on the Service or related Websites has been revised or updated.

10.3 Customer Awareness and Communication:

a) It is important to note that while we strive to provide accurate and up-to-date information, we make no explicit or implicit representation or warranty concerning the content’s accuracy, adequacy, validity, reliability, availability, or completeness. We cannot guarantee the absence of errors, inaccuracies, or omissions. Customers should rely on the most current information available and contact us if they have any questions or concerns regarding the accuracy of the information provided.

11. Prohibited Use Policy:

11.1 Content Usage and Conduct:

a) Users are strictly prohibited from:

(i) Reproducing content without authorization.

(ii) Posting objectionable or infringing material.

(iii) Misusing communication features for spam or malicious intent.

(iv) Introducing viruses or disseminating false information.

(v) Creating privacy risks or impeding access for others.

(vi) Users must adhere to these guidelines, and attempts to evade service blocks are forbidden.

11.2 Identity Verification and Conduct:

a) Users must refrain from:

(i) Impersonating others or disrupting services.

(ii) Violating laws, including unauthorized data collection.

(iii) Misusing the platform for unauthorized purposes.

(iv) Soliciting minors or engaging in unlawful activities.

(v) Circumventing security measures or content restrictions.

11.3 Systematic Data Retrieval and Fraudulent Activities:

a) Users are not allowed to:

(i) Systematically extract data without permission.

(ii) Attempt to deceive or defraud the site or its Users.

(iii) Interfere with security features or site functionality.

(iv) Harm the reputation of MODISHYE Blog or its content.

(v) Utilize site information for harassment or abuse.

11.4 Misuse of Support Services and Compliance with Laws:

a) Users must refrain from:

title: Cookies
html:
Last Updated: November 26, 2026
Effective Date: November 26, 2026

This Cookie Policy outlines the manner in which MODISHYE ("Company", "we", "us", and "our") uses cookies and comparable technologies when you visit our website at www.accordingtomodishyeblog.com ("Website"). It explains what these technologies are, why they may be used, and your rights and options for controlling their use.

Cookies and similar technologies may collect information about your browser, device, website activity, and preferences. In certain circumstances, this information may constitute personal information or personal data, particularly when it can be combined with other information that identifies or relates to an individual.

Data Controller: MODISHYE
Contact Information: support@accordingtomodishyeblog.com

1. WHAT ARE COOKIES?

1.1 Defining a Cookie:

A cookie is a small text file stored on your computer, smartphone, tablet, or other device when you visit a website. Cookies allow a website to recognize your browser or device, remember certain information about your visit, and support website functionality.

Cookies may be temporary, meaning they are deleted when you close your browser (session cookies), or persistent, meaning they remain on your device for a specified period or until you delete them.

1.2 Cookies on MODISHYE's Platform:

a) MODISHYE may use cookies and similar technologies to support website functionality, maintain security, remember visitor preferences, and, where applicable, collect statistical information about website usage and visitor interactions.

b) Depending on the website configuration and the services integrated into the Website, cookies may support features such as session continuity, website navigation, remembering preferences, and processing transactions.

c) The specific cookies used may vary depending on the Website's functionality, third-party integrations, and the services available at the time of your visit.

1.3 Functionalities of Cookies:

a) Cookies and similar technologies may operate automatically when you visit the Website, depending on their purpose and the applicable consent requirements.

b) Cookies may contain identifiers or other information that distinguishes your browser or device. Although some cookies do not directly identify you by name, information collected through cookies may be linked with other information and may constitute personal data.

c) You may manage or disable cookies through your browser settings and, where available, through the Website's cookie preference controls. However, disabling certain cookies may affect some website functions.

d) MODISHYE will seek consent before using cookies or similar technologies where consent is legally required. Strictly necessary cookies may be used without consent where the applicable legal exemption permits their use.

1.4 Utilizing Different Cookies:

a) Cookies established by the owner of the Website, in this instance MODISHYE, are categorized as "first-party cookies." Cookies established by entities other than the Website owner are designated as "third-party cookies."

b) Third-party cookies may be used by external service providers to provide features or functionalities on or through the Website, such as analytics, embedded content, social media features, or advertising, where those services are integrated into the Website.

c) Third-party providers may collect information about your device and browsing activity in accordance with their own privacy and cookie policies. MODISHYE does not control the independent cookie practices of third-party providers and encourages users to review the applicable third-party policies.

Various types of cookies and similar technologies may include:

(i) Strictly Necessary Cookies:

These cookies are essential for the operation, security, and basic functionality of the Website. They may support website navigation, security features, session management, and other functions specifically requested by the visitor. Where these cookies are strictly necessary to provide the requested online service, consent may not be required under applicable law.

(ii) Advertising Cookies:

Where advertising services or advertising technologies are integrated into the Website, advertising cookies may be used to collect information about users' browsing activities, viewed content, followed links, browser, device, or IP address. Such information may be used to measure advertising effectiveness or deliver advertisements based on browsing activity.

Advertising cookies are not treated as strictly necessary. Where required by applicable law, MODISHYE will obtain consent before placing or accessing advertising cookies or using similar tracking technologies for these purposes.

(iii) First-Party Analytics Cookies:

Where analytics tools are integrated into the Website, first-party analytics cookies may help measure website traffic, understand visitor interactions, identify popular pages, and evaluate website performance. The information may be used to improve the Website's content, layout, and functionality.

Whether analytics cookies require consent depends on the applicable law and the nature and configuration of the technology. MODISHYE will obtain consent where required.

(iv) Third-Party Analytics Cookies:

MODISHYE may use third-party analytics services, such as Google Analytics, if integrated into the Website. These services may use cookies or similar technologies to measure visitor interactions, website performance, and traffic patterns.

The use of any specific analytics provider will depend on the Website's actual configuration. Where third-party analytics cookies require consent, they will only be activated after the required consent has been obtained.

(v) Social and Content Cookies:

Where social media plugins, embedded content, videos, or other third-party content are integrated into the Website, those services may use cookies or similar technologies to support their functionality and collect information about visitor interactions.

Some third-party services may also use collected information for analytics, advertising, or market research, subject to their own privacy policies and applicable law. Where consent is required, these technologies will not be activated before the required consent is obtained.

2. WHAT KIND OF COOKIES DO WE USE?

The specific types of first-party and third-party cookies served through our Website, and the purposes they perform, may vary depending on the Website features and third-party services integrated into it.

Cookies may generally be categorized according to their purpose as follows:

a) Essential or Necessary Cookies: Used to support basic website operation, security, and functions requested by visitors.

b) Functional Cookies: Used, where implemented, to remember visitor preferences and improve website usability.

c) Analytics or Performance Cookies: Used, where analytics services are integrated, to understand website traffic, visitor behavior, and website performance.

d) Advertising or Targeting Cookies: Used, where advertising services are integrated, to measure advertising effectiveness or support targeted advertising.

e) Third-Party Cookies: Set by external providers whose services, content, or tools may be integrated into the Website.

The actual cookies, their providers, purposes, and storage durations should be identified in the Website's cookie inventory or cookie preference tool. MODISHYE does not intend this general classification to represent that every category or third-party service is currently active on the Website.

Where available, a cookie preference tool or cookie notice may provide more detailed information about individual cookies, including their names, providers, purposes, and expiration periods.

3. COOKIE MANAGEMENT

3.1 Users can adjust their browser settings to either decline or delete cookies. This can typically be done through the browser's settings or preferences menu. However, rejecting or deleting certain cookies may affect some functionalities of the MODISHYE Website. For example, users may be unable to retain certain preferences, access particular website features, or complete transactions smoothly.

3.2 Users should be aware that blocking cookies may not entirely prevent the collection of information through other technologies, such as tracking pixels, scripts, local storage, or server logs.

3.3 Where the Website uses cookies or similar technologies that require consent, users will be provided with an appropriate mechanism to accept or reject non-essential technologies and manage their preferences. Users should be able to change or withdraw their consent where applicable.
